details:
Description

I guess the description was the same as the title of the bug. Well, the audio works on my end, but it doesn't work on my end because I can talk and be heard, but I don't hear anybody's game sound or any other sound. Yet my computer has all the fucking sound in the world. I can hear all the other shit that happens on my computer, but not in the game. Would it be enough information to tell you my audio is not working because my input is fine, but my output is zero? 

Reproduction Steps

There is no workaround. Your audio is broken. If there was a workaround, I would work around it, but there is no workaround because I've tried uninstalling and reinstalling your game. I've tried turning off my computer, fixing and turning on and off my headset, and changing different headsets. Still, I don't hear anything from VR Chat, but I hear everything from any other game except for VR Chat or any other thing except for VR Chat. I hope telling you that the audio is broken because the output is non-responsive is enough information. 

Details

- Category: Audio

- Frequency: Often
